basic_profile.bio: Originally from a small town in Texas, I'm a 27-year-old customer service representative who recently got into gaming. I mostly play in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM CST. I'm single and often spend my free time exploring new hobbies, like learning about stocks and investments, which led me to the SquareInvestorsClub subreddit. I enjoy music, especially indie artists like Joanna Newsom, and have a keen interest in politics, particularly progressive figures like AOC. I'm also trying to learn Danish, which is why you'll find me lurking on the Danish subreddit. I love chill games like Red Dead Online, where I can unwind without too much pressure.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in customer service and communication, which I've honed through my job. My interest in stocks and investments is mostly self-taught, using online resources and community discussions. I also have a growing interest in language learning and political discourse.
